title: NEBNext® Ultra™ II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext® Ultra™ II FS DNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol forms an automated NGS library prep for the [NEBNext® Ultra™ II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina](https://www.neb.com/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale6177-e7805.pdf?rev=60c9f0ba3c944a708539331d8a71dfbc&hash=B86DFE0923F3F6A7420D1C5A48BB62C5).
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the designated fields of the OT App.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (with .json extensions) as needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your protocol script (.py extension) to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration routine. Refer to the support articles for detailed calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to begin the automated library preparation.
